title: FactBatchV3 — negotiated FactBatch payload when capability token target-attribution-v2 is present
description: CURRENT selected FactBatch payload iff Hello/HelloAck negotiated target-attribution-v2. Preserves historical FactBatchV2 field names analysisOrdinal, stageId, batchIndex, candidates. Occupancy is a PARALLEL occupancyCompanions array, not a FactCandidateV1 field. stageId is the worker echo of the current AnalyzeV2 StageRequestV2.stageOrdinal (exact execution-plan.stages[].ordinal). Host does not invent a second ordinal field. When the token is absent, historical FactBatchV2 remains. A V3 payload without the token, or a V2 payload with the token, is PROVIDER.PROTOCOL_VIOLATION.

schemaVersion.description: Payload discriminator for the negotiated FactBatchV3 contract. Not a narrowing of FactCandidateV1.schemaVersion.

analysisOrdinal.description: Exact echo of AnalyzeV2.analysisOrdinal for this Analyze.

stageId.description: Historical FactBatchV2.stageId preserved. Worker echo of the current AnalyzeV2.stages[k].stageOrdinal. Host associates: batch.stageId == execution-plan.stages[k].ordinal == Analyze StageRequestV2.stageOrdinal. Not a renamed field.

batchIndex.description: Contiguous from 0 for this stage, same as FactBatchV2.

canonicalRelationPayloadHex.description: JSON-vector transcription of FactCandidateV1.canonicalRelationPayload. Those wire bytes are deterministic-CBOR of the closed relation payload (fact-plane.v1 candidateSchema.transportRepresentation). The hex encodes those SAME CBOR bytes, not canonical JSON UTF-8. Admission requires hex == deterministic_cbor(decodedRelationPayload).hex().

decodedRelationPayload.description: Verified TCB observation of one decode of the CBOR payload bytes. Not a wire field. Must round-trip to canonicalRelationPayloadHex via fact-plane _deterministic_cbor.

candidates.description: Non-empty closed FactCandidateV1 membership as a JSON vector. No occupancy field. Order is registered candidateOrdinal (unique nondecreasing integers). Contiguous-within-stage is additional admission. Arrays are not silently sorted.

occupancyCompanions.description: Zero or more OccupancyCompanionV1. Length <= candidates. Every candidateOrdinal names a candidate in this batch. Empty is lawful unknown except exact-id ephemeral. Not silently sorted.

x-opensip-negotiation.stageCorrelation: AnalyzeV2.stages[k].stageOrdinal == execution-plan.stages[k].ordinal is sent to the worker. FactBatch.stageId echoes that integer. Host bind requires batch.stageId == execution-plan.stages[k].ordinal and batch.analysisOrdinal == AnalyzeV2.analysisOrdinal.
x-opensip-negotiation.whenPresent: FactBatch payload MUST admit as this schema
x-opensip-negotiation.whenAbsent: FactBatch payload MUST admit as historical FactBatchV2 (no schemaVersion, no occupancyCompanions).
x-opensip-negotiation.helloLimits: No new ProtocolLimitsV3 member. occupancyCompanions bounded by existing maxFactBatchCandidates 4096 and len(candidates).
